notes.title: Update 1 - Japanese, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Hungarian
notes.notes:
Hey!

The game has been translated to 4 new languages : Japanese, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, and Hungarian. Only possible thanks to the translators, who volunteered to translate it!

[list]
[*] Japanese by Youge(ようげ), ウオザトヲレス | Wallace Uozato, ゲーム実況者 スロースタートのやつ
[*] Spanish by José Fernando Gracia
[*] Brazilian Portuguese by Isaac Magalhaes
[/list]

------

This update also contains a few fixes and quality of life improvements:

[list]
[*] A possible fix for the bookworm achievement. It should work but please report if it is still buggy.
[*] A small page counter which shows how many pages the player has found, and the maximum available pages.
[*] Some small typos fixed.
[/list]

There will be more language updates in the future, and also a Mac build.
Thank you for all your support!

Balazs

notes.title: THANK YOU for 1000 reviews!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45466270/903b28d9bc4631b6e70a617e73f1667f0b7508b7.png[/img]

[b]Thank you so much everyone![/b]

And thanks for everyone who wrote about helping with the translations. We are still working on the first languages, and will post an update as soon as they are ready. The translators are already done, I am just dealing with some technical problems, but hopefully they ll be solved. Then we can move to include more.

Thank you for the support :)



Balazs

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45466270/d97346c5dbd411c8d925ae4d42f291b2b6e0bd85.png[/img]

notes.title: Thank you for 500 reviews!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45466270/1a2099ef243607d9d269d705d4af7514ed057a5b.png[/img]
Thank you so much for reviewing the game everyone. It is surreal to see so many positive reactions.

Also, thanks to translators who volunteered, the game is getting a Brazilian Portuguese , Spanish, and a Japanese translation! Hopefully next month, if all goes well. If you wish to see the game translated to other languages and you can help, feel free to reach out to me.

Thank you for the support :)

Balazs

notes.title: Patch 2
notes.notes:
Patch notes:

- Some players miss what actually happened when they got the Entomologist achievement. Now in order to get it you need to [spoiler] keep looking with the magnifier at that specific part of the sculpture for at least 2 seconds. [/spoiler]
- Fixed a minor typo.

Please report any bugs or technical problems.

Balazs

notes.title: Patch 1
notes.notes:
Patch notes:

- Fixed fps not having a limit. Now it should match the refresh rate of the screen.
- Fixed the aspect ratio problem. Now the game should be playable on all aspect ratios.

Please report any bugs or technical problems!

Balazs
